summary: Iteration 36: Major refactor testing - Unified Jobs System (Quotes = Jobs with status='quote'). All features verified working. Fixed data migration issue with old job statuses.

minor.issue: Old job statuses (in_production, quoted, installed, complete) were causing 500 errors. Data migration applied to convert to new statuses.
minor.resolution: FIXED - Migrated 36 jobs to new status values

key_verifications: ✅ Job creation with status='quote' works (New Quote flow)
✅ Job creation with status='approved' works (New Job flow)
✅ Job filter by 'quotes' returns only status='quote' jobs
✅ Job filter by 'active' returns only approved/in_progress jobs
✅ CRITICAL: Same job ID after approval - NO RECORD DUPLICATION
✅ Approved job removed from quotes filter, appears in active filter
✅ Dashboard active_jobs count excludes quotes (only approved/in_progress)
✅ POST /api/jobs/{id}/send marks quote as sent (sets sent_at)

verifications: ✅ Jobs page loads with unified view
✅ Create New dropdown has 'New Quote (Pipeline)' and 'New Job (Ready for production)' options
✅ Filter bar shows all filters: Quotes, Active, Completed, Invoiced, Archived
✅ Sidebar Sales menu has Jobs link, NO Quotes link (removed)
✅ Dashboard Quick Actions has 'New Quote' and 'New Job' buttons

job_creation_as_quote.description: Jobs can be created with status='quote' via New Quote option. Line items and total calculated correctly.

job_creation_as_approved.description: Jobs can be created with status='approved' via New Job option (ready for production).

job_status_filtering.notes: Active filter shows only approved/in_progress. Quotes filter shows only status='quote'.

job_approve_action.behavior: Changes status from 'quote' to 'approved', sets approved_at timestamp. SAME RECORD - no duplication.

dashboard_active_jobs_count.description: Active Jobs stat only counts approved and in_progress jobs. Jobs with status='quote' are NOT included.

sidebar_quotes_removed.description: Quotes nav item removed from sidebar. Only Jobs link visible under Sales menu.

data_migration_performed.description: Migrated old job statuses to new enum values

critical_code_review_comments: The jobs.py routes file has a duplicate 'return jobs' statement at lines 188-189 - minor cleanup needed
seed_data_creation: Test quotes/jobs created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major refactor complete - Quotes and Jobs unified into single Jobs collection. Quote = Job with status='quote'. All filtering and approval workflows working. Data migration was needed to convert old status values (in_production -> in_progress, quoted -> quote, etc.).

api_endpoints_tested.POST /api/jobs (status=approved): Working - Creates job ready for production
api_endpoints_tested.POST /api/jobs/{id}/approve: Working - Changes quote to approved, same ID
